notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light - Patch to version 1.13
notes.content:
A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light v1.13 brings minor changes and some bugfixes / improvements on the levels. The credit list has been updated, enemy placements and gameplay elements in certain levels have been changed to make the level more enjoyable and issues with Steam achievements and stats should have been fixed. Achievements and stats should now sync themselves between your savefile and Steam.

[b]What's coming next?[/b]
There will be some more minor changes to level design according to feedback and a slight rework of the animations. Stay tuned!

notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light v1.12 - Day 1 Patch
notes.content: v1.12 - Day 1 Patch is now here for "A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light". Fixed a visual bug for enemies in level 2-2, some difficulty patches and adjusted the playbackspeed of some animations.

notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light Demo Version Update
notes.content: Typo in tutorial section of the game fixed and improved footstep sounds depending on ground material. Also fixed some minor issues with the first two levels.

notes.title: "A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light" Free Demo coming Sep. 21, 2023
notes.content:
A demo of my indie action platformer "A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light" is coming to Steam now! Explore two levels, learn powerful abilities, level up, defeat enemies and solve puzzles as you make your way through stormy forests and mysterious caves. The demo includes two full levels, 6 abilities, 20+ secrets & collectables and around 1h of playtime. The demo is available in english and german, but the full game will include french, italian, spanish and romanian as well :)
